fields.msgid:
IT LOOKS LIKE YOUR SYSTEMS CONFIGURATION FILE HAS NOT BEEN SET UP OR IS INVALID. YOU'LL NEED TO DO THIS BY HAND, UNFORTUNATELY.

VISIT EMULATIONSTATION.ORG FOR MORE INFORMATION.
fields.msgstr:
IL SEMBLE QUE VOTRE FICHIER DE CONFIGURATION DES SYSTÈMES N’AIT PAS ÉTÉ CRÉÉ OU SOIT INVALIDE. IL FAUDRA, HÉLAS, LE FAIRE À LA MAIN.

VOIR EMULATIONSTATION.ORG POUR PLUS D’INFORMATIONS.

source_calls.source:
_("IT LOOKS LIKE YOUR SYSTEMS CONFIGURATION FILE HAS NOT BEEN SET UP OR IS INVALID. YOU'LL NEED TO DO THIS BY HAND, UNFORTUNATELY.\n\n"
			"VISIT EMULATIONSTATION.ORG FOR MORE INFORMATION.")

fields.msgid:
WE CAN'T FIND ANY SYSTEMS!
CHECK THAT YOUR PATHS ARE CORRECT IN THE SYSTEMS CONFIGURATION FILE, AND YOUR GAME DIRECTORY HAS AT LEAST ONE GAME WITH THE CORRECT EXTENSION.

VISIT EMULATIONSTATION.ORG FOR MORE INFORMATION.
fields.msgstr:
AUCUN SYSTÈME TROUVÉ !
VÉRIFIEZ LES CHEMINS DU FICHIER DE CONFIGURATION DES SYSTÈMES, ET QUE VOTRE DOSSIER DE JEUX CONTIENT AU MOINS UN JEU AVEC LA BONNE EXTENSION.

VOIR EMULATIONSTATION.ORG POUR PLUS D’INFORMATIONS.

source_calls.source:
_("WE CAN'T FIND ANY SYSTEMS!\n"
			"CHECK THAT YOUR PATHS ARE CORRECT IN THE SYSTEMS CONFIGURATION FILE, "
			"AND YOUR GAME DIRECTORY HAS AT LEAST ONE GAME WITH THE CORRECT EXTENSION.\n\n"
			"VISIT EMULATIONSTATION.ORG FOR MORE INFORMATION.")
